tips.label: 先主詞，再動詞
tips.text: 間接問句放進另一個句子後，使用「疑問詞＋主詞＋動詞」：Do you know where the file is?

tips.label: do／does／did 的處理
tips.text: 一般肯定間接問句去掉問句用的 do／does／did，動詞恢復人稱與時態：where she lives、what he bought。

tips.label: who 可能就是主詞
tips.text: who 本來就是動作者時，直接接動詞，不用再倒裝：I know who sent the e-mail.

tips.label: 疑問詞＋to V
tips.text: 主詞明確且語意適合時，可用 what／which／where／when／how＋to＋原形動詞：how to upload a file。

tips.label: 是否：whether／if
tips.text: Yes/No 問句改成 whether／if＋主詞＋動詞；不定詞前只能用 whether：whether to save it。

tips.label: 標點看最外層
tips.text: Do you know ...? 用問號；I don’t know ... . 用句號。不能只看句中有沒有疑問詞。

notes.title: 間接問句與直述語序
notes.rule: 主要子句＋疑問詞＋主詞＋動詞
notes.description: 把問句放進 know、tell、ask、wonder、remember 等後面時，子句採直述語序。含 be 動詞時，主詞放在 be 動詞前；be 動詞仍須配合單複數和時間。句末標點由主要子句決定。
examples: Where is the key? → Do you know where the key is?（你知道鑰匙在哪裡嗎？）
Why was the screen dark? → I wonder why the screen was dark.（我想知道螢幕當時為什麼是黑的。）
Where are the lamps? → Please tell me where the lamps are.（請告訴我檯燈在哪裡。）

notes.title: 一般動詞：去掉問句助動詞，保留人稱與時態
notes.rule: 疑問詞＋主詞＋一般現在式／過去式動詞
notes.description: 一般肯定間接問句不保留直接問句用來倒裝的 do、does、did。does 所表示的第三人稱單數要回到主要動詞；did 所表示的過去時間也要回到主要動詞。不要一律把動詞寫成原形。
examples: Where does Mia save her files? → I know where Mia saves her files.（我知道 Mia 把檔案存在哪裡。）
What did you type? → Please tell me what you typed.（請告訴我你打了什麼。）
否定子句仍可能需要助動詞：I know why he does not come here anymore.（我知道他為什麼不再來這裡。）

notes.title: 情態助動詞與現在完成式
notes.rule: 疑問詞＋主詞＋can／should／will＋原形動詞；疑問詞＋主詞＋have／has＋過去分詞
notes.description: can、should、will 和完成式的 have／has 不要刪掉，只須放回主詞後面。完成式要留意主詞單複數及過去分詞。how long、so far、yet 等可協助理解時間。
examples: When will you upload the photo? → Tell me when you will upload the photo.（告訴我你何時會上傳照片。）
How can I fix this error? → Show me how I can fix this error.（示範給我看怎樣修正這個錯誤。）
How long have you had this cellphone? → I wonder how long you have had this cellphone.（我想知道你這支手機用了多久。）

notes.title: 疑問詞本身就是主詞
notes.description: 先找出誰在做動作。who 或 which machine 等本來就是主詞時，後面直接接動詞，無須再調整語序。若 who 是受詞，則要保留另外的主詞。主動與被動也要依誰做事、誰受影響判斷。
examples: Who sent the file? → I know who sent the file.（我知道誰寄了檔案。）
Which machine boils water? → Tell me which machine boils water.（告訴我哪台機器會煮水。）
I know who helped Ken.（我知道誰幫了 Ken。）／I know who Ken helped.（我知道 Ken 幫了誰。）
I know who was chosen.（我知道誰被選上了。）

notes.title: wh- 名詞片語
notes.description: 主詞明確，且意思是「該做什麼、如何做、在哪裡做」時，可用疑問詞加不定詞。to 後面一定是原形動詞。不是任何間接問句都能這樣簡化；本課不使用 why to V，疑問詞本身是主詞時也不能直接改成這種結構。
examples: Please show me how I can upload a file. = Please show me how to upload a file.（請示範如何上傳檔案。）
I cannot decide which lamp I should buy. = I cannot decide which lamp to buy.（我無法決定該買哪盞檯燈。）
I know who should help us.（我知道誰應該幫我們。）此處 who 是主詞，不能改成 who to help us。

notes.title: whether／if 引導是否子句
notes.description: 原問句可以用 Yes 或 No 回答時，改成間接問句須用 whether 或 if 引導，子句仍用直述語序。一般受詞子句中兩者常能互換；or not 在句尾時兩者都可使用。if 在這裡表示「是否」，不是「如果」。
examples: Is the machine working? → I wonder whether the machine is working.（我想知道機器是否正常運作。）
Did Sam come? → I do not know if Sam came.（我不知道 Sam 是否來過。）
I wonder whether she will come or not. = I wonder if she will come or not.（我想知道她會不會來。）

notes.title: whether 的特殊位置與選擇問句
notes.rule: whether＋to V；whether or not＋主詞＋動詞
notes.description: 不定詞 to V 前只能用 whether，不能用 if。補充：or not 緊接引導詞時也要用 whether or not；若 or not 放在子句末尾，一般受詞子句可用 whether 或 if。or 也可以連接兩個實際選項，此時不必再加 not。
examples: I cannot decide whether to save the file.（我無法決定是否要儲存檔案。）
Please check whether or not the shop is open.（請確認店是否開著。）
Do you know whether she goes by bus or metro?（你知道她搭公車還是捷運嗎？）

notes.title: 用上下文選疑問詞
notes.rule: what 問內容；who 問人；where 問地點；when 問時間；why 問原因；how 問方式
notes.description: 除了語序，還要看子句缺少什麼資訊。回答提供地點就用 where，提供原因就用 why；what 可以作子句受詞。how much 問價錢或不可數的量，how many 問可數數量，how often 問頻率，how long 問時間長度。
examples: Tell me what you wrote.（告訴我你寫了什麼。）
Do you know why the screen is dark? Because the machine is off.（你知道螢幕為什麼黑了嗎？因為機器關著。）
Can you tell me how much this cellphone costs?（你能告訴我這支手機多少錢嗎？）

notes.title: 被動語態放進間接問句
notes.rule: 疑問詞／whether／if＋主詞＋be 動詞＋過去分詞
notes.description: 主詞是承受動作的對象時，使用被動語態。改成間接問句後，不要因為調整語序就刪掉 be 動詞，也不要把過去分詞改成原形。
examples: Why was the file deleted? → I wonder why the file was deleted.（我想知道檔案為什麼被刪除。）
Was the machine made in Taiwan? → I want to know whether the machine was made in Taiwan.（我想知道這台機器是否在臺灣製造。）

notes.title: 整個名詞子句作主詞
notes.description: 間接問句形式的名詞子句也可以放在句首作主詞。此時把整件事視為單數，所以主要子句用 is、has 等單數動詞；不要被子句裡的複數名詞影響。
examples: Where the lamps will be placed is still unknown.（檯燈將放在哪裡仍不清楚。）
Who took the key is not clear.（誰拿了鑰匙還不清楚。）
Whether the machine works has not been checked.（機器是否能運作還沒檢查。）

quiz.question: The gate is locked. Do you know where ___?
quiz.hint: know 後的 where 子句使用直述語序「主詞＋be 動詞」，所以填 the key is，不能倒裝成 is the key。

quiz.question: Please tell me why ___. I cannot see anything on it.
quiz.hint: tell me 後的間接問句用 why＋主詞＋be 動詞＋形容詞，因此是 the screen is dark。

quiz.question: A: Whose cellphone is this? B: I don't know whose cellphone ___.
quiz.hint: this 是子句主詞。直接問句的 is this 改成間接問句時，要還原為 this is。

quiz.question: Can you tell me where the lamps ___?
quiz.hint: 間接問句中的主詞是複數 the lamps，be 動詞用 are，且放在主詞後面。

quiz.question: I wonder how old this machine ___.
quiz.hint: how old 後面接主詞 this machine，再接 be 動詞；單數主詞用 is，表示這台機器有多久的歷史。

quiz.question: Do you remember where ___ yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，單數主詞 the couch 搭配 was；間接問句仍須主詞在前。

quiz.question: Please tell me how often Mia ___ her files. Does she do it every day?
quiz.hint: Mia 是第三人稱單數；every day 所指的是習慣。間接問句保留一般現在式的人稱變化，所以用 saves。

quiz.question: I don't know where Tom ___ his key last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去，leave 要用過去式 left。間接問句不保留問句用的 did。

quiz.question: Could you tell me why ___ this button yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去；why 後接主詞 you，再接過去式 pushed，不用 did you push 的倒裝語序。

quiz.question: Do you know what time the store ___ every morning?
quiz.hint: every morning 表示固定習慣，單數主詞 the store 的一般現在式動詞用 opens。

quiz.question: I wonder how ___ her name on the screen yesterday.
quiz.hint: 間接問句使用 how＋主詞＋動詞。yesterday 提示過去式，因此是 she typed。

quiz.question: Mom wants to know when ___ the soup.
quiz.hint: 情態助動詞 will 在間接問句中放在主詞 we 後面，後接原形動詞 heat。

quiz.question: Could you tell me which button ___ to start the machine?
quiz.hint: 間接問句用 I should push，先主詞 I，再接 should＋原形動詞 push。

quiz.question: Nobody knows where ___ the couch tomorrow.
quiz.hint: where 後用直述語序 they can place；can 後接原形動詞，不加 do，也不使用 placed。

quiz.question: I want to know how ___ this error.
quiz.hint: how 引導的間接問句須使用主詞 I＋can＋原形動詞 correct，不能將 can 放到 I 前面。

quiz.question: Can you tell me how long ___ this cellphone?
quiz.hint: 現在完成式的間接問句用主詞＋have／has＋過去分詞；you 搭配 have，因此是 you have had。

quiz.question: Mom asks whether Nina ___ the e-mail yet.
quiz.hint: yet 配合此處語境詢問是否已寄出，使用現在完成式；Nina 是單數，搭配 has＋sent。

quiz.question: Do you know how many coins ___ so far?
quiz.hint: so far 表示到目前為止；現在完成式間接問句用 Leo has collected，主詞先於 has。

quiz.question: I wonder where ___ the file.
quiz.hint: 現在完成式的間接問句採主詞 Dad＋has＋saved，不能沿用 has Dad 的問句倒裝。

quiz.question: Someone wrote on the blackboard. Do you know who ___ it?
quiz.hint: who 本身就是「寫字的人」，是子句主詞，後面直接接過去式 wrote，不再加助動詞 did。

quiz.question: A: One of these machines makes hot water. B: Can you tell me which machine ___ water?
quiz.hint: which machine 是子句主詞，視為單數，直接接一般現在式 boils；不需倒裝或改成不定詞。

quiz.question: The file appeared in my e-mail. I wonder who ___ it to me.
quiz.hint: who 是寄件者，也是子句主詞；前句 appeared 提示已發生的事件，因此直接用過去式 sent。

quiz.question: I want to thank the person who helped me. Do you remember who ___?
quiz.hint: 語境要找「曾幫助我的人」，who 是施助者，故用 who has helped me；I have helped 會變成我幫助的人，方向相反。

quiz.question: Someone took my cellphone. Please tell me who ___.
quiz.hint: who 是拿走手機的人，直接接 took it。it 指手機，應作 took 的受詞，不能把 it 放在動詞前當主詞。

quiz.question: The file is on my computer. Please show me how ___ it to the cloud.
quiz.hint: 主詞明確且是在詢問操作方法，可用 how＋to＋原形動詞，因此填 to upload。

quiz.question: We have two lamps, but only one table. I cannot decide which lamp ___.
quiz.hint: which lamp 後可接 to＋原形動詞，表示不知道應保留哪盞燈，因此是 which lamp to keep。

quiz.question: A: The soup is cold. B: Please teach me how ___ it.
quiz.hint: teach me how to heat 表示教我如何加熱；how 後的名詞片語使用 to＋原形動詞。

quiz.question: Please tell me where ___ this heavy couch.
quiz.hint: where to place 表示應放在哪裡；不定詞 to 後要接原形 place。

quiz.question: I have never used a voice assistant. Can you show me how ___ to it?
quiz.hint: 詢問如何對語音助理說話，使用 how to talk；to 後不能接 talked 或 V-ing。

quiz.question: There are five buttons. I don't know which one ___.
quiz.hint: which one to push 表示不知道該按哪一個；疑問詞片語後接 to＋原形動詞 push。

quiz.question: The quiz begins soon. We must decide when ___.
quiz.hint: when＋to＋原形動詞可表達決定何時做某事；to 後使用原形 start，所以填 to start studying。

quiz.question: I have an empty shopping list. Please tell me what ___.
quiz.hint: what to buy 表示該買什麼；主詞明確時可用 what＋to＋原形動詞的名詞片語。

quiz.question: I cannot decide ___ to save this file or delete it.
quiz.hint: 表示「是否要」且後接 to V 時，只能用 whether，不能用 if；or delete it 提供另一個選項。

quiz.question: A: Could you ask Tina ___ she can lend us her cellphone? B: Sure. I'll ask her for a yes or no.
quiz.hint: for a yes or no 表示詢問是否願意借手機；she can lend us her cellphone 是完整子句，前面用 if。

quiz.question: We don't know ___ the new machine will work or not.
quiz.hint: or not 表示「是否」，後面的 the new machine will work 已是完整子句，使用 whether 引導。

quiz.question: Could you check if ___ in the refrigerator?
quiz.hint: if 引導的間接問句也採直述語序；複數主詞 the eggs 放在 are 前面。

quiz.question: I wonder whether Sam ___ to the quiz yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 提示過去時間。whether 子句中的 come 要改成過去式 came，不能因為是間接問句就忽略時態。

quiz.question: Do you know whether ___ the file tomorrow?
quiz.hint: tomorrow 提示未來；whether 後使用主詞 May＋will＋原形動詞 upload，不使用倒裝。

quiz.question: Ken has not answered my message. I wonder ___ he has read it.
quiz.hint: 想知道 Ken 是否讀過訊息，使用 if。he has read it 結構完整，不缺人或事物的受詞。

quiz.question: Please find out ___ or not the shop sells lamps.
quiz.hint: or not 緊接引導詞時，使用 whether or not；if 不能直接接 or not。

quiz.question: I cannot decide whether ___ this machine today.
quiz.hint: whether 後可以接 to＋原形動詞，表示是否要購買，因此填 to buy。

quiz.question: I want to know whether this machine ___ in Taiwan.
quiz.hint: 機器是「被製造」的對象，使用被動語態 be＋過去分詞，所以是 was made；其餘選項都是主動結構。

quiz.question: A: Do you know ___ the file is? B: Yes. It is on my desktop.
quiz.hint: 回答 on my desktop 提供位置，因此用 where；when 問時間，why 問原因，whether 問是否。

quiz.question: A: Can you tell me ___ the quiz starts? B: At nine.
quiz.hint: At nine 回答時間，所以用 when 引導間接問句，後面維持 the quiz starts 的直述語序。

quiz.question: A: Do you know ___ the screen is black? B: Because the machine is off.
quiz.hint: Because 引導的回答提供原因，所以空格用 why；子句語序仍是 the screen is black。

quiz.question: A: Please tell me ___ you wrote in the e-mail. B: I wrote my new address.
quiz.hint: 回答提供寫下的「內容」。wrote 後缺受詞，使用 what；where、when 是地點或時間，whether 表是否。

quiz.question: A: Can you tell me ___ the new cellphone costs? B: Ten thousand dollars.
quiz.hint: Ten thousand dollars 是價錢，應問 how much；how many 問可數數量，how often 問頻率，how long 問時間長度。

quiz.question: Where we will place the couch ___ still a question.
quiz.hint: 整個 Where we will place the couch 子句作主詞，視為單數，後面用 is。

quiz.question: Who took the key ___ not clear yet.
quiz.hint: 主詞是整個 Who took the key 子句，意思是「誰拿走鑰匙這件事」，視為單數，使用 is。

quiz.question: Whether the machine works ___ not been checked yet.
quiz.hint: 整個 Whether the machine works 子句作主詞，視為單數；搭配 not been checked yet，使用 has 形成現在完成式被動。

vocab.sentence: I'll wait for you in front of the gate.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我會在大門前等你。

vocab.sentence: You can download the files from this web page.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你可以從這個網頁下載檔案。

vocab.sentence: Do you know when the quiz will start?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道小考什麼時候開始嗎？

vocab.sentence: Please tell me what is on the blackboard.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我黑板上有什麼。

vocab.sentence: I don't know where the chalk is.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我不知道粉筆在哪裡。

vocab.sentence: Can you tell me why the screen is dark?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你能告訴我螢幕為什麼是黑的嗎？

vocab.sentence: Do you know how to fix this error?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道怎麼修正這個錯誤嗎？

vocab.sentence: I am not sure which button to push.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我不確定該按哪個按鈕。

vocab.sentence: Please show me how to enter my name.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請示範如何輸入我的名字。

vocab.sentence: Can you tell me what the wake word is?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你能告訴我喚醒字詞是什麼嗎？

vocab.sentence: I don't know whether she will come.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我不知道她是否會來。

vocab.sentence: Do you know where my shopping list is?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道我的購物清單在哪裡嗎？

vocab.sentence: Honey, do you know where my keys are?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 親愛的，你知道我的鑰匙在哪裡嗎？

vocab.sentence: Please teach me how to save this file.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請教我如何儲存這個檔案。

vocab.sentence: I wonder whether I can buy tickets through this app.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我想知道是否能透過這個應用程式買票。

vocab.sentence: I wonder if the store is open.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我想知道這家店是否開著。

vocab.sentence: Do you know why he doesn't live here anymore?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道他為什麼不再住這裡嗎？

vocab.sentence: Do you know how to use the voice assistant?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道如何使用語音助理嗎？

vocab.sentence: Can you show me how to use this machine?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你能示範如何使用這台機器嗎？

vocab.sentence: Do you know whether we need a dozen eggs?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道我們是否需要一打蛋嗎？

vocab.sentence: Please show me how to boil water.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請示範如何把水煮沸。

vocab.sentence: Do you know what is in the refrigerator?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道冰箱裡有什麼嗎？

vocab.sentence: I don't know how to upload the photo.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我不知道如何上傳這張照片。

vocab.sentence: Can you tell me who sent this e-mail?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你能告訴我誰寄了這封電子郵件嗎？

vocab.sentence: I forgot where I put my key.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我忘了把鑰匙放在哪裡。

vocab.sentence: Please show me how to save photos to the cloud.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請示範如何把照片存到雲端。

vocab.sentence: Do you know how to type your name?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道如何打出你的名字嗎？

vocab.sentence: Do you know what time the sun will rise tomorrow?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道明天太陽幾點升起嗎？

vocab.sentence: I wonder why he collects old buttons.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我想知道他為什麼收集舊鈕扣。

vocab.sentence: Do you know whether this lamp still works?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道這盞檯燈是否還能用嗎？

vocab.sentence: Please tell me where to put the couch.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我該把沙發放在哪裡。

vocab.sentence: I don't know how to heat the soup.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我不知道如何加熱這碗湯。

vocab.sentence: Do you know whose cellphone this is?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道這是誰的手機嗎？

vocab.sentence: Please teach me how to correct this error.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請教我如何更正這個錯誤。

vocab.sentence: I wonder why this message appears on the screen.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我想知道這個訊息為什麼出現在螢幕上。

vocab.sentence: Please tell me where to place the lamp.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我該把檯燈放在哪裡。

vocab.sentence: Do you know how much fat is in this food?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你知道這個食物含多少脂肪嗎？

vocab.sentence: Please show me where to point the camera.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請示範該把相機對準哪裡。

grammar.sentence: Do you know where the gate is?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你知道大門在哪裡嗎？

grammar.sentence: Please tell me which file to open.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我該開啟哪個檔案。

grammar.sentence: I wonder whether the machine still works.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我想知道這台機器是否還能運作。

grammar.sentence: Can you show me how to save this?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你能示範如何儲存這個嗎？

grammar.sentence: Nobody knows who broke the blackboard yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 沒有人知道昨天誰弄壞了黑板。

grammar.sentence: We cannot decide where to place the couch.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們無法決定該把沙發放在哪裡。

grammar.sentence: Mom asked me why the screen was dark.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 媽媽問我螢幕為什麼是黑的。

grammar.sentence: I don't know when the quiz will start.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我不知道小考什麼時候開始。

grammar.sentence: Please check if the eggs are fresh.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請檢查這些蛋是否新鮮。

grammar.sentence: Dad knows how to correct this error.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸知道如何更正這個錯誤。

grammar.sentence: Tell me whose cellphone this is.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 告訴我這是誰的手機。

grammar.sentence: I wonder why she collects old keys.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我想知道她為什麼收集舊鑰匙。

grammar.sentence: Do you remember who sent this e-mail?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你記得誰寄了這封電子郵件嗎？

grammar.sentence: We haven't decided which lamp to buy.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們還沒決定該買哪盞檯燈。

grammar.sentence: Can you explain how the voice assistant works?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你能解釋語音助理如何運作嗎？

grammar.sentence: I am not sure whether to press this button.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我不確定是否該按這個按鈕。

grammar.sentence: Please tell me how long you have waited.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我你等了多久。

grammar.sentence: Nobody knows where he saved the file.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 沒有人知道他把檔案存在哪裡。

grammar.sentence: She asked whether I could help her.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她問我是否能幫她。

grammar.sentence: Do you know what is inside the refrigerator?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你知道冰箱裡有什麼嗎？

grammar.sentence: I cannot remember which machine boils water.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我不記得哪台機器會煮水。

grammar.sentence: Tell me whether this list is correct.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 告訴我這份清單是否正確。

grammar.sentence: We want to learn how to type faster.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們想學如何打字打得更快。

grammar.sentence: I wonder whether he has uploaded the photo.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我想知道他是否已經上傳照片。

grammar.sentence: Please show me where to point the camera.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請示範該把相機對準哪裡。

grammar.sentence: Who took my key is still unknown.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 誰拿了我的鑰匙仍然不清楚。

grammar.sentence: I know why he doesn't come here anymore.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我知道他為什麼不再來這裡。

grammar.sentence: Mom asked what I wanted for dinner.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 媽媽問我晚餐想吃什麼。

grammar.sentence: Please tell me when the sun will rise.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我太陽什麼時候會升起。

grammar.sentence: Whether the soup is hot is not clear.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 湯是否是熱的還不清楚。

cloze_quiz.question: The school fence has a large ___ that students walk through every morning.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 學校圍牆有一道大門，學生每天早上從那裡進出。
cloze_quiz.hint: gate 是大門；圍牆上供人通過的出入口是大門。

cloze_quiz.question: The report is a computer ___, so I can copy it to a USB drive.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這份報告是電腦檔案，所以我可以把它複製到隨身碟。
cloze_quiz.hint: file 是檔案；能複製到隨身碟的電腦報告是檔案。

cloze_quiz.question: We answered five questions in a short ___, and the teacher gave us our scores.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我們在一次簡短的小考中回答了五個問題，老師給了我們分數。
cloze_quiz.hint: quiz 是小考；回答題目並取得分數的課堂活動是小考。

cloze_quiz.question: The teacher writes with chalk on the ___ at the front of the classroom.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 老師用粉筆在教室前方的黑板上寫字。
cloze_quiz.hint: blackboard 是黑板；教室裡供老師用粉筆書寫的板子是黑板。

cloze_quiz.question: The teacher picked up a piece of white ___ to write on the blackboard.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 老師拿起一支白色粉筆，在黑板上寫字。
cloze_quiz.hint: chalk 是粉筆，常用 a piece of chalk 表示一支粉筆，用來在黑板上寫字。

cloze_quiz.question: The picture on my cellphone's ___ is too dark to see.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我手機螢幕上的圖片太暗，看不清楚。
cloze_quiz.hint: screen 是螢幕；手機用來顯示圖片的部分是螢幕。

cloze_quiz.question: I typed 18 instead of 81. Please correct this ___.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我把 81 打成 18，請更正這個錯誤。
cloze_quiz.hint: error 是錯誤；把數字打錯是一個需要更正的錯誤。

cloze_quiz.question: To turn on the fan, press the green ___ on the front.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 要開啟電風扇，請按前方的綠色按鈕。
cloze_quiz.hint: button 是按鈕；press 和 turn on 提示要按控制開關的按鈕，不是扇葉、電線或外蓋。

cloze_quiz.question: Before the website lets you log in, you must ___ your password in this box.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 網站讓你登入前，你必須在這個欄位輸入密碼。
cloze_quiz.hint: enter 在此是輸入；登入時需在欄位中輸入密碼。

cloze_quiz.question: The phrase 'Hey, Helper' is the ___ that makes the voice assistant start listening.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: Hey, Helper 這個詞語是讓語音助理開始聆聽的喚醒字詞。
cloze_quiz.hint: wake word 是喚醒字詞，用來啟動語音助理的聆聽功能；不是檔名、電子郵件地址或電話號碼。

cloze_quiz.question: I cannot decide ___ to keep this old machine or sell it.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我無法決定要保留這台舊機器，還是把它賣掉。
cloze_quiz.hint: whether 表是否；後接 to keep 時只能用 whether，不能用 if。

cloze_quiz.question: I wrote milk, eggs, and bread on my shopping ___ so I wouldn't forget them.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我把牛奶、雞蛋和麵包寫在購物清單上，免得忘記。
cloze_quiz.hint: list 是清單；把要買的東西逐項寫下來，就是購物清單。

cloze_quiz.question: Dad called Mom by a loving name and said, '___, I missed you.'
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 爸爸親暱地稱呼媽媽，說：「親愛的，我很想你。」
cloze_quiz.hint: honey 在本課是對親近之人的稱呼「親愛的」；句中的 loving name 提示親暱稱呼。

cloze_quiz.question: To keep the new file on your computer, remember to ___ it before closing the program.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 為了把新檔案保留在電腦裡，關閉程式前記得儲存它。
cloze_quiz.hint: save 是儲存；要把新檔案保留下來必須儲存，刪除、開啟或重新命名都不等於儲存。

cloze_quiz.question: You can buy tickets ___ this app without going to the station.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 你可以透過這個應用程式買票，不必去車站。
cloze_quiz.hint: through 在此表示透過某種管道；購票的管道是這個應用程式。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ask her ___ she wants tea. I need a yes or no.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 請問她是否想喝茶，我需要一個肯定或否定的回答。
cloze_quiz.hint: if 在這裡是是否；a yes or no 顯示要確認她想不想喝茶，不是在說原因、讓步或截止時間。

cloze_quiz.question: I stopped playing this game last year. I ___.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我去年就停止玩這個遊戲了，現在不再玩。
cloze_quiz.hint: not... anymore 表示不再；stopped playing last year 提示已經停止，不能選仍然每天或每晚玩的選項。

cloze_quiz.question: I spoke to the ___, and it answered my question aloud without anyone typing.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我對語音助理說話，它直接用聲音回答問題，沒有人打字。
cloze_quiz.hint: voice assistant 是語音助理，能接收口頭指令並以語音回應；充電器、螢幕保護蓋和滑鼠不能這樣回答問題。

cloze_quiz.question: The factory uses a large ___ to cut wood automatically.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 工廠使用一台大型機器自動切割木材。
cloze_quiz.hint: machine 是機器；能自動切割木材的是機器，其他選項沒有這種功能。

cloze_quiz.question: There are twelve eggs in the box. That is one ___.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 盒子裡有十二顆蛋，也就是一打。
cloze_quiz.hint: dozen 表示一打，也就是十二個；pair 是一對，half 是一半，hundred 是一百。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ the water until you see large bubbles rising to the top.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 請把水煮沸，直到看見大氣泡往上冒。
cloze_quiz.hint: boil 是煮沸；水中不斷出現往上冒的大氣泡是煮沸的線索。

cloze_quiz.question: Put the milk in the ___ to keep it cold.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 把牛奶放進冰箱，讓它保持冰涼。
cloze_quiz.hint: refrigerator 是冰箱；keep it cold 提示需要冷藏，烤箱、抽屜和櫥櫃都不是冷藏設備。

cloze_quiz.question: To share the photo online, ___ it from your cellphone to the website.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 要在線上分享照片，請把它從手機上傳到網站。
cloze_quiz.hint: upload 是上傳，方向是從自己的裝置傳到網站；download 是從網路下載到裝置，方向相反。

cloze_quiz.question: I sent you an ___ from my computer; check your inbox.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我從電腦寄了一封電子郵件給你，請查看收件匣。
cloze_quiz.hint: e-mail 是電子郵件；sent 和 inbox（收件匣）提示寄送的是郵件。

cloze_quiz.question: The door is locked. Use this ___ to unlock it.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 門鎖住了，用這把鑰匙把它打開。
cloze_quiz.hint: key 是鑰匙；locked 和 unlock 提示要用鑰匙開鎖。

cloze_quiz.question: I saved my photos to ___, so I can see them online from another computer.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我把照片存到雲端，所以可以用另一台電腦上網查看。
cloze_quiz.hint: the cloud 是雲端；能透過網路從不同電腦查看資料，表示資料存放在雲端。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ your name using the letters on the keyboard.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 請使用鍵盤上的字母打出你的名字。
cloze_quiz.hint: type 是打字；using the letters on the keyboard 提示用鍵盤輸入文字。

cloze_quiz.question: The sun will ___ in the east tomorrow morning.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 太陽明天早上會從東方升起。
cloze_quiz.hint: rise 是上升、升起；morning 和 in the east 提示日出，set 則是落下。

cloze_quiz.question: Every time I visit a new city, I buy a postcard. I ___ postcards as a hobby.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 每次到一個新的城市，我都買一張明信片，收集明信片是我的嗜好。
cloze_quiz.hint: collect 是收集；到不同城市購買並留存明信片，表示以收集明信片為嗜好。

cloze_quiz.question: I turned on the ___ beside my bed so I could read at night.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我打開床邊的檯燈，好在晚上看書。
cloze_quiz.hint: lamp 是檯燈；turned on 和 read at night 提示需要提供光線的檯燈。

cloze_quiz.question: The ___ in our living room is a long, soft seat for several people.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 客廳裡的沙發是一張可以坐好幾個人的柔軟長椅。
cloze_quiz.hint: couch 是沙發；long, soft seat for several people 描述的是供多人坐的沙發。

cloze_quiz.question: The soup is cold. Please ___ it on the stove for a minute.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 湯冷了，請放在爐子上加熱一分鐘。
cloze_quiz.hint: heat 是加熱；湯冷了而且放上爐子，目的是提高溫度，其他選項都表示降溫或冷凍。

cloze_quiz.question: I use my ___ to make calls when I am away from home.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 出門在外時，我用手機打電話。
cloze_quiz.hint: cellphone 是手機；可以隨身攜帶並用來撥打電話。

cloze_quiz.question: The answer is wrong. Please ___ it before handing in your paper.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這個答案錯了，交卷前請把它更正。
cloze_quiz.hint: correct 在此是動詞「更正」；答案有錯，需要先修正再交卷。

cloze_quiz.question: When you turn on the screen, a welcome message will ___ and become visible.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 打開螢幕時，歡迎訊息就會出現，讓你看見。
cloze_quiz.hint: appear 是出現；become visible 表示變得看得見，與出現的意思相符。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ the lamp on the desk; don't leave it on the floor.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 請把檯燈放在書桌上，不要留在地板上。
cloze_quiz.hint: place 在本課是動詞「放置」；on the desk 和 don't leave it on the floor 提示把物品放到指定位置。

cloze_quiz.question: This food contains too much ___, so it is very oily.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這個食物含有太多脂肪，所以很油膩。
cloze_quiz.hint: fat 在本課是名詞「脂肪」；very oily 表示油膩，與脂肪多有關。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ the camera at the bird before taking a picture.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 拍照前，請把相機對準那隻鳥。
cloze_quiz.hint: point 在此是對準；point the camera at... 表示把相機朝向要拍攝的對象。
